overview: Dr. Lucas Pozzo-Miller completed his university studies in Biology (1986) and earned his Doctorate in Biology (1989), both from the Universidad Nacional de Córdoba, Argentina. He trained as postdoctoral fellow at Case Western Reserve University, Cleveland OH (1990-1992), and at the former Roche Institute of Molecular Biology, Nutley NJ (1992-1995). Dr. Pozzo-Miller performed summer research at the Marine Biological Laboratory, Woods Hole MA (1994 Grass Foundation Fellow and 1995 Lakian Foundation Fellow), and was a Senior Staff Fellow at NINDS, NIH, Bethesda MD (1995-1998). Dr. Pozzo-Miller joined the Department of Neurobiology at the University of Alabama at Birmingham in 1998, and is currently Professor of Neurobiology.
